description: Make a listening page for the user when choosing sounds for several events (a whole app or game): your candidates grouped by event, about three each, your recommendation first. The user opens listen_url, plays each one, picks one per event, can leave a note (“lower”, “shorter”) and presses Done; then call get_picks. Give the user listen_url before downloading anything for those events; if they say “you decide”, download your recommendations instead. Sounds are slugs from search_sounds, get_role_sound or get_sound_set. The page works for 24 hours; with an API key only this key's account reads the picks back. Up to 40 events of 1–5 sounds.

label.description: Optional: how the page names it

recommended.description: Optional: your pick among sounds (the first when left out)

title.description: The project in a few words, shown on the page, e.g. 'Platformer: forest level'

name: create_listen_page
